mentions.name: Fish Bait
mentions.description: This is a 2-4 player casual card game similar to Exploding Kittens, designed as a free-to-play mobile title. It is built with Unity for the front-end and Node.js for the game servers, with current focus on marketing through ads, short-form content, and influencer outreach.
mentions.source_excerpt: A 2-4 player casual card game that's similar to Exploding Kittens. It'll be free-to-play on mobile and I've been focusing more on marketing these days (mostly running ads, creating short form content, and reaching out to influencers).
